column8: Protocols: MScs purchased from young and old human donors miRNAeasy kit for RNA extraction Total RNA samples were ribosomal RNA depleted using the Human, mouse, rat low inputRibozero kit from Epicentre. 1ug of RNA (or the max amount available) was mixed with the low input kit baits and allowed to anneal. This was then mixed with the magnetic microspheres which bind the ribosomal complexes and subsequently pulled out with a magnet. The remaining RNA was purified with RNA clean beads and analysed with the Agilent Bioanalyser with a RNA pico chip. Recovery was generally less than 1% of the original starting material. All of this material was used in the script seq reaction (Epicentre). Samples were denatured and annealed to cDNA primers and cDNA was generated. This was amplified with indexed primers for 15 cycles to make the library for sequencing. Libraries were checked on the Agilent Bioanalyser with a High sensitivity chip and quantities determined with Qubit DNA High sensitivity reagents.

column13: Bulk RNA-seq Total RNA was extracted from sampled human brains using miRNeasy Mini Kite and homogenized in Qiazol using stainless steel beads. Chloroform was then used for phase separation. RNA containing an aqueous layer was further purified using the RNeasy MinElute spin column. RNA was finally eluted in RNase-free water. For bulk RNA-seq librairies were prepared using Ribo-Zero gold sample preparation kit. Library concentrations were measured using KAPA Illumina Library Quantification Kit. Polled libraries were sequenced on Illumina NovaSeq6000 sequencer with 150-bp Paired-End chemistry.

column13: RNA was isolated from  PAXgene® Blood RNA collection tube (BD 762165) as described in the PAXgene® Blood miRNA Kit Handbook (December, 2015). Purified RNA was quantified by UV spectrophotometry using the DropSense96® Microplate Spectrophotometer (Trinean) and quality assessed by microfluidics using the RNA ScreenTape on the Agilent 2200 TapeStation. Starting with 500 ng of total RNA, cDNA library templates were synthesized using the Illumina TruSeq® Stranded Total RNA LT (Set A) Kit with Ribo-Zero Globin rRNA reduction, as described in the TruSeq® Stranded Total RNA Sample Preparation Guide (Rev. E, October 2013). Libraries were validated using the HS D1000 ScreenTape on the Agilent 2200 TapeStation, and quantified on the Qubit® 2.0 Fluorometer by the Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay (ThermoFisher). The Illumina HiSeq 2500 instrument was used to cluster the samples onto the flow cell. The pools were put on at 10pM and run in rapid mode at 2×100 paired end. Illumina HiSeq Rapid PE Cluster kit V2 and HiSeq Rapid SBS kit v2 200 cycles was used.
